name: accelerating-gap
description: An ion released at rest in a uniform 10 kV/m field and collected 100 mm away. The acceleration is qE/m and the flight time is sqrt(2d/a), which is 10.1805 us for m/z 500. A source may declare a zero accelerating potential exactly when a declared field could accelerate the ion - a trap holds its packet still until the instrument switches a field on, and this is the simplest instance of that.
